changes: Enabled firewall upgrades offer guarded hook application and a fresh SSH confirmation after IPv4/IPv6 checks; disabled firewalls remain disabled.
Independent timeout recovery restores previous owned rules, metadata and source after failed apply or SSH loss; foreign rules and existing bans are preserved.
Deferral keeps the previous boot hook and reports migration pending. Manager 2.0.11 / Firewall 4.0.3; use --apply-firewall interactively after upgrading.
